;Armed conflicts and attacks
*At least 15 people are killed in northern [[Burkina Faso]] after a convoy transporting traders is targeted by an unidentified armed group. Burkina Faso [[Operation Barkhane|has been fighting]] [[Islamist]] [[terrorists]] amid a resurgence of attacks in the [[Sahel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burkina-security/attack-in-northern-burkina-faso-kills-at-least-15-idUSKBN2360FO?il=0 (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] says he is terminating the country's relationship with the [[World Health Organization]] (WHO) over its handling of the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], claiming the WHO has become a "puppet of [[China]]" and that American funding will be redirected to "other global public health needs". [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-trump-who/trump-says-terminating-u-s-relationship-with-world-health-organization-over-virus-idUKKBN2352Y7?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Murder of George Floyd]]
**[[George Floyd protests]]
***[[List of George Floyd protests in the United States|George Floyd protests in the United States]]
****[[George Floyd protests in California]]
*****[[George Floyd protests in Los Angeles County, California]]
******In [[Los Angeles]], more than 500 people are arrested as the city declares the protest an "unlawful assembly". [https://deadline.com/2020/05/lapd-makes-more-than-500-arrests-in-friday-street-protests-mayor-garcetti-calls-for-peaceful-end-1202947292/ (''Deadline'')]
****[[George Floyd protests in Georgia]]
*****[[George Floyd protests in Atlanta]]
******In [[Atlanta]], the [[CNN Center]] is vandalized and [[Atlanta Police Department|police]] vehicles are attacked and set on fire as protests spread. Seven people are reportedly arrested. [https://www.newsweek.com/george-floyd-protesters-smash-windows-cnn-center-atlanta-1507538 (''Newsweek'')]
****[[George Floyd protests in Illinois]]
*****[[George Floyd protests in Chicago]]
******In [[Chicago]], 108 people are arrested after several [[Chicago Police Department|police]] vehicles are vandalized. [https://wgntv.com/news/chicago-news/several-arrests-made-after-chicago-protest-over-george-floyds-death/ (WGN-TV)]
****[[George Floyd protests in Minnesota]]
*****[[George Floyd protests in Minneapolis–Saint Paul]]
******Hundreds of [[Minnesota National Guard]] are deployed in [[Minneapolis]] to enforce a night [[curfew]], after [[List of mayors of Minneapolis|Mayor]] [[Jacob Frey]] declared a state of local emergency amid civil unrest, but rioting and [[arson]] fires continue. [https://www.startribune.com/suburbs-join-st-paul-mpls-in-ordering-curfews-starting-at-8-p-m-friday/570873142/ (''Star Tribune'')]
****[[George Floyd protests in Michigan]]
*****In [[Detroit]], police use tear gas to disperse a crowd of protesters and make several arrests, including one person who drove their car at a police officer. A man was killed during an altercation during the protests. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/30/us/detroit-man-shot-protests/index.html (CNN)]
****[[George Floyd protests in Texas]]
*****In [[Houston]], at least 137 people are arrested, eight [[Houston Police Department|police]] officers are hospitalized, and 16 police vehicles are vandalized in a riot. [https://www.khou.com/article/news/local/black-lives-matter-plans-friday-rally-for-justice-for-george/285-561ef235-8aa9-48ac-8755-0bc4fec0b768 (KHOU)]
***Several other protests against [[Police brutality in the United States|police brutality]] and [[Institutional racism#In criminal conviction|systemic racism]] take place in large cities across the United States, some of which included arson, [[vandalism]], and [[looting]].  [https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/george-floyd-protest-updates-05-28-20/index.html (CNN)]
**Former [[Minneapolis Police Department|Minneapolis Police]] officer [[Derek Chauvin]], who was recorded on video kneeling on [[George Floyd]]'s neck for several minutes and eventually causing his death, is taken into custody by the [[Minnesota Bureau of Criminal Apprehension]] and charged with third-degree [[murder (United States law)|murder]] and second degree [[manslaughter]]. [https://kstp.com/news/arresting-officer-derek-chauvin-taken-into-custody-by-bca-george-floyd-case/5743589/?cat=1 (KSTP)] [https://minnesota.cbslocal.com/2020/05/29/derek-chauvin-arrested-george-floyd-death-minneapolis-police-officer/ (WCCO)]
*[[Taiwan]] decriminalises [[adultery]] in what is considered a landmark ruling. Marital [[infidelity]] was a crime with a maximum sentence of a year in prison. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-court-adultery/taiwan-decriminalises-adultery-in-landmark-ruling-idUSKBN23519A?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Lesotho]]'s Appeal Court revokes former First Lady [[Maesiah Thabane]]'s bail. Thabane and her husband, former Lesotho [[List of prime ministers of Lesotho|Prime Minister]] [[Tom Thabane]], are accused of ordering the [[murder]] of his first wife, [[Lipolelo Thabane|Lipolelo]]. Both deny involvement in the crime. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-appeal-courts-revokes-bail-granted-to-former-leaders-wife-idUSKBN2352BK (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[LGBT rights in Hong Kong]]
**Pro-democracy and [[LGBT rights]] [[activist]] [[Jimmy Sham]] files a petition to the [[High Court (Hong Kong)|High Court]] to recognize his [[same-sex marriage]], which was registered in [[New York City]] in 2014. Sham argues that not recognizing same-sex marriages violates the [[Hong Kong Basic Law|Basic Law]]. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3086771/lawyers-hong-kong-rights-activist-jimmy-sham-urge (''South China Morning Post'')]

;Science and technology
*A [[SpaceX Starship]] prototype (SN4) is destroyed in a large explosion during static fire testing at the [[SpaceX South Texas Launch Site]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/05/29/spacex-prototype-starship-rocket-explodes-after-test-in-texas.html (CNBC)]
